supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Check ordinal on every line, even non-Scale. Scale exact kind uses Reaction Break and A14 return time for both event and stop scan. Any other kind uses line.source_index, A10 event and source main open+TF stop start; final candles[index] read even when unused.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Reset event reconstructs first strict lower cross of broken_level in source main half-open window. No hit returns main open even if nonempty lower rows; no main OHLC crossing assertion.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Number all sorted lines before filtering validity. Internal lines included. Normalize sourceExtreme as stop threshold. A07 result tuple truthiness controls all four optional stop fields, zero index in tuple remains valid. Main time read by stop[0]; line reference retained.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Valid line replaces predecessor then continues. Any false-validity line can attempt double-stop (no kind check). Missing predecessor skips. Use invalid line.source_time as start, main open+TF as end. First crossing must map to same invalid source index; no further search.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Trigger comes from crossing. A15 aligns with not_before=invalid line.source_time, not source main timestamp unless equal. Matched First/Break converted before A17 source lookup. No match or source retains predecessor.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Record both stop main times as invalid source main timestamp, semantic stop levels from individual Blue sources. Continuation price/index/time from previous line. Trigger event and mapped main separate, A source separately selected. Exact stop provenance omitted/default null, route double-stop. Clear predecessor only after successful append.
